page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for parallel computing and compute-intensive tasks. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The hardware configuration includes two discrete NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. Additionally, the instance is provisioned with 944 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The inclusion of dual NVIDIA P100 GPUs alongside substantial host memory and dedicated compute cores establishes a capable environment for legacy deep learning and scientific modeling tasks. Because local SSD storage is directly attached, applications benefit from local read and write capabilities without requiring separate block storage attachments. However, the reliance on Pascal-generation GPU architecture represents a hardware trade-off, offering lower tensor-processing efficiency compared to newer GPU generations, while remaining functional for general parallel acceleration.

Given its balance of 56 vCPUs, 224 GB RAM, dual discrete acceleration units, and local SSD storage, Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge fits workloads such as computer vision inference, legacy deep learning training, scientific simulations, high-performance video encoding, and parallel data analytics pipelines.
